note: Coordinates approximate. Overlays show zone extents. Refine with in-game data.

zones.name: Silverwood
zones.description: Lush forested starting zone for Guardians, home to Argent Glade and the capital Sanctum.

zones.name: Argent Glade
zones.description: Peaceful starting area within Silverwood, where new Guardians arrive.

zones.name: Sanctum
zones.description: The Guardian capital city. A beacon of light and faith in Telara.

zones.name: Freemarch
zones.description: Defiant starting zone. Sun-scorched plains surrounding the technomantic capital Meridian.

zones.name: Meridian
zones.description: The Defiant capital. A marvel of magitech engineering carved into the desert.

zones.name: Stonefield
zones.description: Rocky highlands rich with ancient Titan technology and Earth rifts.

zones.name: Gloamwood
zones.description: Perpetually twilight forest haunted by Death rifts and the undead.

zones.name: Scarwood Reach
zones.description: Blighted scarred landscape where the Ward was shattered, releasing planar horrors.

zones.name: Moonshade Highlands
zones.description: Ancient Dwarven highlands under perpetual moonlight. Rich in Life and Death rifts.

zones.name: Droughtlands
zones.description: Sun-blasted desert with Fire rifts. Home to ruthless bandit clans and ancient ruins.

zones.name: Shimmersand
zones.description: Vast shimmering desert with ancient Eth artifact sites and Air rifts.

zones.name: Iron Pine Peak
zones.description: Frozen mountain peaks. The Icewatch keeps vigil over ancient Water rift prisons.

zones.name: Stillmoor
zones.description: Regulos-touched endgame zone. The final bastion against the Dragon of Death.

zones.name: Ember Isle
zones.description: Volcanic island off the coast. Post-launch endgame zone with powerful planar bosses.

zones.name: Tempest Bay
zones.description: Storm Legion expansion hub city on Ember Isle. Neutral trading port.
